items.title: Gucci Primavera is here: Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan, and more front Demna's new era
items.summary: Philippine daily covers Gucci's first Demna-era global campaign, Primavera, built around themes of love and renewal and fronted by a 10-person cast including BTS' Jin, aespa's Ningning, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, Tom Brady, Kate Moss and Shawn Mendes; frames the heavy Asian-celebrity casting as a deliberate play for Asian-market relevance under the new creative direction.

items.title: Gucci's New Campaign Gets It: Asian Stars Rule Fashion Now
items.summary: Manila-based lifestyle outlet argues Gucci's Primavera cast (Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, Tarzzan) signals a structural shift in luxury marketing toward Asian stars as primary demand drivers rather than token inclusions, tying the campaign to the region's outsized share of brand engagement.

items.title: Hanoi: From a shop selling fake Louis Vuitton, Gucci bags, a manufacturing workshop is exposed
items.summary: Vietnamese outlet reports Hanoi police busted a counterfeit ring selling fake LV and Gucci handbags, wallets and belts (priced 2-10 million VND) out of a Kim Lien retail unit, tracing the goods to a connected production workshop; the two operators had accumulated roughly 4.2 billion VND since 2022, reflecting an active counterfeit-goods enforcement wave against Gucci and peers in Vietnam.

items.source: Kering H1 2026 results coverage (WWD / Manila Times syndication)
items.title: Kering 2026 first-half results: back to growth, Gucci retail accelerates
items.summary: Kering's official H1 2026 release, syndicated via Manila Times, shows Gucci directly-operated retail sales down 2% in Q2 (a 7-point sequential improvement from Q1's decline), with Western Europe and Asia-Pacific cited as showing early signs of recovery even as mainland China remains soft; used here as the most recent primary financial disclosure still shaping SEA trade/analyst commentary into September.

items.title: Gucci and Dior both exited KLCC Malaysia over high rent, shifting to TRX/Pavilion
items.summary: Threads post aggregating local Malaysian social chatter states Gucci and Dior both exited Suria KLCC mall due to elevated rents, relocating to TRX and Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, framed within Kering's broader plan to close up to a net 80 stores globally by end-2025; engagement was modest (10 likes) but the underlying closure is corroborated by a Lowyat.net forum thread titled "Gucci KLCC permanently closed."

items.title: Gucci KLCC permanently closed
items.summary: Thread on Malaysia's largest tech/lifestyle forum (Lowyat) discussing the permanent closure of the Gucci boutique at Suria KLCC, one of Kuala Lumpur's flagship malls; page could not be fully rendered (403) but the thread title and continued indexing under "Gucci KLCC tutup sepenuhnya" on TikTok discovery pages confirm sustained local community discussion of the store exit as a visible signal of Gucci's retreat from a marquee KL location.

items.title: Looking for the cheapest item at Gucci, but even a bandana costs Rp2.8 million
items.summary: Indonesian pop-culture/community site recaps a viral consumer anecdote (originating on social video) about a shopper visiting a Gucci boutique looking for the most affordable item, only to find a plain fabric bandana priced at Rp2.8 million (~$175) and available for pickup only at the airport boutique; comment threads reflect ongoing Indonesian consumer sentiment that Gucci pricing is disconnected from perceived material value.

items.title: BTS Member's Brand Photos Hit With Brutal Comments Amid Alleged Fan-Controversy With Top Actor
items.summary: K-pop community/fan-news outlet reports Jin's official Gucci campaign posts were flooded with hostile Chinese-language comments after the ambassador-treatment dispute with Xiao Zhan fans escalated; notes Jin's Chinese fanclub issued a public apology to Xiao Zhan, illustrating how a Gucci campaign moment turned into sustained negative-toned comment brigading on the brand's own posts.

items.title: VMAN Southeast Asia covers Gucci's La Famiglia local-arrival screening in Manila
items.summary: Regional culture/fashion Instagram account VMAN SEA posted a reel documenting Gucci's Manila event marking the local arrival of Demna's La Famiglia collection, held at Ayala Museum with a screening of Spike Jonze/Halina Reijn short film "The Tiger" and SB19 members in attendance; retained as a benchmark SNS engagement data point (1.4K likes, 52 comments) since it is one of the only SEA Gucci social posts with visible metrics, despite being older than the ideal freshness window.
